_how: Real products you picked on Amazon with SiteStripe. 'link' = SiteStripe 'Full link' (or just the 10-letter ASIN). 'channels' = which channel ids may use it (see config/channels.json). When a channel has at least 4 products here, its videos use only these and link straight to each product page; otherwise they link to an Amazon search. Never add a product you have not opened on Amazon.
